summary.name: The Many Ways Your Monitoring Is Lying to You
summary.one_liner: A 2016 SREcon talk by Google SRE Sebastian Kirsch on how monitoring and dashboarding systems can mislead engineers and hide production issues.
use_cases: Learning how monitoring systems can mislead on-call engineers
Reviewing your own dashboards for hidden failure modes
Preparing SRE training on monitoring pitfalls
Understanding why an outage was not visible in metrics
summary.what_it_does: The page is the listing for a talk at SREcon (USENIX, Dublin, 2016) by Sebastian Kirsch of Google. The talk walks through examples of how a monitoring system can lead engineers on wild goose chases or hide real issues. Its stated goal is to make the audience aware of these failure modes and encourage them to look for similar problems in their own systems. The page includes a speaker bio: Kirsch manages the team running Google Calendar and has worked on Google's web crawler and Google Maps. The page does not describe specific examples or tools in the talk.
notable: Covers concrete examples of monitoring systems giving misleading results
Presented by a Google SRE who manages the Google Calendar team
Part of USENIX SREcon conference, Dublin 2016
caveats: Page is a talk listing; no slides, video, or transcript text is included
Specific examples and recommendations are not described on the page
